_context.price.monthly: {amount} is a price in its currency, like "$29". /mo = per month.
_context.price.hire: Button on a paid template's page. {count} is the number of coworkers it installs, {price} its price like "$29" or "$29/mo".
_context.price.hireCard: Short button revealed on a paid template card. {price} is its price like "$29" or "$29/mo".
_context.categories.legal: A template category: the businesses it serves.
_context.connectors.none: Shown on a template card instead of the app logos when the template connects no app.
_context.connectors.label: Screen reader label of the row of app logos on a template card. {apps} is a comma separated list of app names (Gmail, HubSpot).
